remarks: Charming and Vacant revitalized first-floor farmhouse in one of South Norwalk's most desirable waterfront neighborhoods! Just a short walk to the SoNo Metro-North station, The SoNo Collection, waterfront parks, and the area's best restaurants, cafes, and shops. Enjoy seasonal harbor views on your shared wrap around porch and grand foyer. *UPSTAIRS 2 BEDROOM IS COMING SOON* (see cross property). The apartment has timeless farmhouse details throughout including beautiful original hardwood floors, period lighting, tall windows and soaring 9+ ft. ceilings. Every room blends vintage charm with thoughtful updates. The spacious living room has a classic built-in cupboard and opens to a large eat-in country kitchen and features an industrial-style six-burner gas range, dishwasher and walk in pantry. The bedroom is large and sun-filled with large closet - the second is a walkthrough - perfect for a home office, nursery, or guest room with original grand pocket doors. The updated full bath is equipped with walk in shower. Outside, relax in the lovely shared garden backyard-an ideal spot for morning coffee or unwinding after a long day. If you're looking for charm, convenience, and a walkable lifestyle near the water, this special home is a rare opportunity. Easy commute to NYC and close to everything that makes South Norwalk one of Fairfield County's most vibrant communities. *HEAT IS INCLUDED*. Shared basement storage space and laundry. Street parking only.
